name: test-manage
description: A single-page, offline-capable tool for authoring exam/quiz questions (with justifications for every option) and assembling them into tests. Built to support writing multiple-choice questions in the "question + correct answer + wrong answers, each with a justification" style, tagging them by topic, and composing tests out of a shared bank rather than writing each test's questions from scratch.

scripts.build: npm run build:elm && npm run build:css
